paragraphs.text:
Rather than single anyone or anything in particular out, you 
feel it would be best to use your time to get a general impression 
and speak to multiple people to get their points of view.

Hearing the talk around the room, you come to understand 
that most of the people who have gathered here are merely 
treating this as a social event. However, there are a fair number 
of academics and collectors in attendance as well. Judging by 
the relative wealth of the townsfolk, you imagine that there will 
be a lot of bids placed on the items.

While walking among the guests, you happen to notice a 
pair of men conversing in hushed tones. They seem to be trying 
to avoid being overheard, but a keen ear might be able to catch 
what is being said.
• Make a Listen roll: if you succeed, go to 2; if you fail, go to 44.
